He authored the Sanskrit play Mattavilasa Prahasana and initiated the construction of the famous cave temples at Mahabalipuram. s: What is the evidence that Narayanabhattu helped Nannayabhattu in the process of translation of Mahabharata?
x:
The Nandampudi Donation Inscription is the primary historical evidence showing that Narayanabhattu assisted Nannaya Bhattu in translating the Mahabharata into Telugu. The inscription records that Rajaraja Narendra granted the village of Nandampudi as an agrahara in recognition of the literary services rendered by Narayanabhattu. It also acknowledges his scholarly assistance to Nannaya during the translation of the Mahabharata. This inscription is therefore an important source for understanding the collaborative efforts behind the earliest Telugu Mahabharata and the literary patronage extended by the Eastern Chalukya rulers. Hence, the correct answer is Option (1).
Exam Note:
• Evidence – Nandampudi Donation Inscription
• Patron – Rajaraja Narendra
• Importance – Confirms Narayanabhattu's assistance to Nannaya
